lighthouse_detail: full_data captured; all failing audits (score < 0.9, excluding informative/notApplicable) recorded per URL

url_selection.notes: No audit-urls.txt. service-landing tie at priority 9.0 (fire, mold, water); kept water + fire to match the 2026-08-26 baseline. url-plan has no primary: true service-area and no /service-areas/santa-maria-ca/ page (primary city is excluded from area pages), so fell back to the first area slug, vandenberg-village-ca, same as the baseline.

environment_caveats: Audited the apex production site https://callcrs.com (apex_cutover.completed_at 2026-09-08T17:52:50Z). curl -sI confirmed HTTP 200 and no x-robots-tag header on all six URLs, so SEO counts toward the verdict this run.

The prior audit (2026-08-26) ran against the Cloudflare Pages staging preview with a noindex artifact (SEO 69 on every URL). The SEO delta (+31) reflects the environment change, not a site change. Performance numbers also move between Pages preview and apex+CDN, so small LCP deltas are not treated as site changes.
Lighthouse ran DESKTOP only (formFactor=desktop, cpuSlowdownMultiplier=1, throughputKbps=10240). Mobile scores would typically land 10-20 performance points lower.

The named MCP tools on_page_lighthouse and on_page_instant_pages are not exposed by this DataForSEO MCP build. Used authenticated REST calls to /v3/on_page/lighthouse/live/json (full_data: true) and /v3/on_page/instant_pages, piped to disk. Total API cost about $0.041.

DataForSEO instant_pages checks has_render_blocking_resources (duplicates Lighthouse render-blocking-insight), no_image_title (the img title attribute has no SEO weight) and low_content_rate (text-to-HTML ratio; word counts are healthy) were not recorded as issues.
Issue IDs prefixed rankai_ are Rank AI derived checks, not Lighthouse or DataForSEO audit IDs. All unprefixed IDs are genuine vendor IDs.
